candidate.title: SCRB-Seq
candidate.scope: The assigned Illumina SCRB-Seq (single-cell RNA barcoding and sequencing) row, from Cell suspension through the final cDNA library, interpreted at schematic scope using the Soumillon et al. 2014 original 3-prime digital-gene-expression architecture (bioRxiv DOI 10.1101/003236). The matching secondary page is headed SCRB-Seq and captions its matching diagram A schematic overview of SCRB-Seq. The row contains one path with pooling of products from repeated single-cell preparations, and no alternative target branch. The small Single cell/poly(A) cartoon identifies the analyte. Neighboring Nuc-Seq, Div-Seq and scM&T-seq rows and their chemistry are context, not additional target methods. Literal synthesis captions and their primary-supported resolutions are recorded explicitly. This is a compact architecture, not a complete experimental implementation.

features: The endpoint is explicitly labeled cDNA and drawn as a black line without internal segment labels.
Readout carrier is DNA copied from mRNA, carrying transcript-derived sequence associated with a well/cell barcode and UMI.

In the primary implementation, multiplexed sequencing surveys strand-aware 3-prime gene-expression tags. Barcode association assigns a tag to its source well/cell; UMIs support counting distinct tagged molecules rather than amplified copies.

The representation concerns captured poly(A)+ transcripts and is a 3-prime digital-expression survey; it does not establish exhaustive transcript recovery or full-length transcript/isoform reconstruction.
Sequencing and data processing are downstream interpretation of this library, not additional operations drawn in the SCRB-Seq row.
